request.spec:
Invoices should move through stages. First a draft. Then I send it. Then it gets paid. Keep a
record when I send one. Only let me take payment once it has been sent.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read CLAUDE.md — it states the working rules, the project layout, and the data-testid
conventions. Follow it.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Invoices should move through stages. First a draft. Then I send it. Then it gets paid. Keep a
record when I send one. Only let me take payment once it has been sent.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, and any audit records it
expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as you work;
iterate until it passes. Implement the full-stack change (database migration + OfficeFloor
server + front-end). Do NOT edit the pinned scaffolding (bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop,
bin/e2e, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md) or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Both tests pass. Let me verify the full-stack change is coherent — the change request is implemented across all layers:

**Database** (`V9__invoice_draft_status.sql`): invoice status default is now `DRAFT`, reflecting the new DRAFT → SENT → PAID lifecycle.

**Server:**
- `Invoice` — new invoices start `DRAFT`; added `markSent()` and `isSent()`.
- `SendInvoice` + `SendInvoiceForm` + `invoices/send.POST.yml` — new `POST /api/invoices/send` endpoint that flips DRAFT → SENT and records `INVOICE_SENT id=… amount=…` through the `Audit` service (the record kept every time one is sent).
- `PayInvoice` — now rejects payment unless the invoice has been sent, enforcing the ordering server-side, not just in the UI.
- `TestSupportController` — seed defaults status to `DRAFT` and tolerates fixtures that omit dates.

**Front-end:**
- `send.slot.tsx` — new per-row action; the `invoice-send-{id}` button appears only while the row is `DRAFT`, queries its own status under the shared `['invoices', projectId]` key, and invalidates it on success.
- `pay.slot.tsx` — the `invoice-pay-{id}` button now renders only once the invoice is `SENT`, so a draft cannot be paid.
- `api.ts` — added `sendInvoice`.

Every change is additive and follows the slot/query/URL conventions; no pinned scaffolding or the test spec was touched. `npm run typecheck` passes and both Playwright specs are green.
